route_policy: Reuse existing routes and libraries; map concrete endpoints in evidence/upstream-map.json; no duplicate unguarded implementation.
internal_user_key: existing User.id (integer), retained in all domain relations

migrate: password from String(60) to Text before new hash writes
User.rule: No new shadow User table or user-ID renumbering.

clinic_account_policy.default: local_only for newly provisioned local accounts; migrate existing accounts explicitly, never grant local rights to pre-existing SSO-only users

clinic_external_identity.nullable_unique_rule: Tenant/Object partial uniqueness for Entra records only; both null for non-Entra identities. Identity consistency checked on every login.

clinic_identity_link_request.rule: Explicit approved target; no account merge or email matching; consume and bind in one transaction.

clinic_local_recovery.rule: Hash only; single-use; default TTL 30 minutes; cannot alter account policy/status.

session.reuse: existing session model/service if sufficient; otherwise established compatible server-side library
session.rule: Only opaque session reference in browser.

clinic_external_actor_mapping.rule: KIS actor mapping independent of login provider. Local users do not require fake OIDC identities.

invariants: Account active, globally enabled provider and permitted account policy are all required for login.
Local-disabled or Entra-only remains disabled through reset, IdP outage, hidden admin URL and legacy route.
Linking does not change User.id, recordings, pool routing, device ownership or past approvals.
No email/UPN/name-based linking, JIT role provisioning or clinical grants from SSO claims.
Provider identity and policy mutation, version increment, audit and session invalidation are atomic.
A conflicting or replayed external identity binding is rejected, never reassigned.
Last active locally accessible identity administrator is protected against accidental removal.
External provider disabled means no discovery/JWKS/network dependency during startup/login.

commands.name: CreateLocalUser
commands.effect: pending_activation; local_only; existing User.id; no password in response

commands.name: BootstrapIdentityAdmin
commands.request: hidden input or protected one-time activation
commands.effect: one-time first identity admin; no web bootstrap; no clinical read privilege
commands.response: success or conflict; no secret logging

commands.name: IssueLocalActivation
commands.effect: one-time code returned once; persisted hash; pending user unchanged until activation

commands.name: CompleteLocalActivation
commands.effect: set hash; active; consume token; no full auto-login

commands.name: AuthenticateLocal
commands.effect: provider/account/status/rate/hash checks; rotate session; no access before activation
commands.response: normal session or generic rejection; 429 throttled

commands.name: ChangeLocalPassword
commands.effect: replace hash; revoke recovery tokens and other sessions; rotate current session

commands.name: IssueLocalRecovery
commands.effect: only currently local-eligible active user; revoke sessions; no policy change

commands.name: CompleteLocalRecovery
commands.effect: consume reset atomically; set hash; no auto-login/re-enablement

commands.name: SetUserStatus
commands.effect: version++ and revoke sessions; refuse last local identity admin removal

commands.name: SetUserRolesAndPools
commands.effect: deny unapproved self-elevation; version++ and audit; no content read implied

commands.name: CreateEntraLinkRequest
commands.effect: pending approved link; no active identity until callback verified

commands.name: StartEntraLink
commands.authorization: target user + fresh local auth + approved link
commands.effect: bind OAuth state to user/session/purpose; no browser-selected target identity

commands.name: CompleteEntraLink
commands.effect: atomic issuer/sub and tid/oid matching; same user.id; default entra_only and remove local hash; revoke sessions
commands.response: normal signed-in result or generic rejection; no unapproved linking

commands.name: AuthenticateEntra
commands.effect: validate claims; lookup explicit identity; check account status/policy; no roles from claims
commands.response: normal session or denied/pending provisioning; disabled route no side effect

commands.name: SetLoginPolicy
commands.effect: only valid active credentials/verified identity; no implicit local reactivation; dual requires audited exception

commands.name: UnlinkExternalIdentity
commands.effect: revoke sessions; keep history; no password auto-enable; maintain recoverable permitted access or explicitly disable user

commands.name: Logout
commands.effect: server invalidates session; no global change to other providers
